verdict.rationale: AngelList is a SaaS platform, so offering scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents API keys, tokens, or permission scoping, and the OpenAPI probe found every candidate path returning 404. The HRIS integrations and the llms.txt file are adjacent features, not scoped credential issuance, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
